examples.text_en: They built this school for posterity and the future.
examples.text_zh: 他们建造这所学校是为了子孙后代和未来。

examples.text_en: We must keep the land safe for posterity.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须为子孙后代保护好这片土地。

examples.text_en: She began her postgraduate studies last year.
examples.text_zh: 她去年开始了研究生阶段的学习。

examples.text_en: He teaches a postgraduate course in physics.
examples.text_zh: 他教一门物理学研究生课程。

examples.text_en: The book was a posthumous work of the man.
examples.text_zh: 这本书是那人的遗作。

examples.text_en: They gave him a posthumous name after his death.
examples.text_zh: 他去世后，他们追授了他一个称号。

examples.text_en: The postmaster sorted the mail every morning.
examples.text_zh: 邮政局长每天早晨分拣邮件。

examples.text_en: A new postmaster took charge of the office.
examples.text_zh: 一位新邮政局长接管了这个邮局。

examples.text_en: The postoperative care was a great help to him.
examples.text_zh: 术后的护理对他帮助很大。

examples.text_en: She felt much better after the postoperative rest.
examples.text_zh: 术后休息之后，她感觉好多了。

examples.text_en: He added a short postscript at the end of the page.
examples.text_zh: 他在页面末尾加了一小段附言。

examples.text_en: The postscript gave us one more important thing to do.
examples.text_zh: 这段附言又交给我们一件重要的事。

examples.text_en: The plan rests on a postulate about human needs.
examples.text_zh: 这个计划建立在一个关于人类需求的假定之上。

examples.text_en: They postulate that people act for their own good.
examples.text_zh: 他们假定人们是为自己的利益行事。

examples.text_en: His posture was straight and very strong.
examples.text_zh: 他的姿势挺拔，显得很有力。

examples.text_en: Her posture was good in front of the group.
examples.text_zh: 她在小组面前姿态端正。

examples.text_en: The postwar years brought many social changes.
examples.text_zh: 战后的岁月带来了许多社会变化。

examples.text_en: They built new homes in the postwar period.
examples.text_zh: 战后时期他们建起了新住房。

examples.text_en: The village needs clean potable water.
examples.text_zh: 这个村子需要干净的饮用水。

examples.text_en: We found potable water near the camp.
examples.text_zh: 我们在营地附近找到了饮用水。

examples.text_en: The land is full of potash and good for food.
examples.text_zh: 这片土地富含钾碱，适合种粮食。

examples.text_en: They use potash to help the green life here.
examples.text_zh: 他们用钾碱来帮助这里的绿色植物生长。

examples.text_en: He had a small potation before the long talk.
examples.text_zh: 长篇讲话之前，他喝了一小口酒。

examples.text_en: A potation of hot water can help on a hard day.
examples.text_zh: 在难熬的日子里，喝一口热水会有帮助。

examples.text_en: That book was a potboiler and not real art.
examples.text_zh: 那本书是粗制滥造之作，算不上真正的艺术。

examples.text_en: He made potboiler work to pay for his food.
examples.text_zh: 他靠写粗制滥造的东西来赚饭钱。

examples.text_en: This drug is very potent and works fast.
examples.text_zh: 这种药药效很强，见效很快。

examples.text_en: Their words had a potent effect on us.
examples.text_zh: 他们的话对我们影响很大。

examples.text_en: The potentate had the land for many long years.
examples.text_zh: 这位统治者拥有这片土地很多年。

examples.text_en: A potentate can make a law with a single word.
examples.text_zh: 统治者一句话就能制定一条法律。

examples.text_en: The potentiality of the plan was clear to us.
examples.text_zh: 这个计划的潜在可能性我们看得很清楚。

examples.text_en: Every child has the potentiality to learn a lot.
examples.text_zh: 每个孩子都有学会很多东西的潜力。

examples.text_en: The plan is potentially very useful for us.
examples.text_zh: 这个计划对我们可能非常有用。

examples.text_en: This change could potentially solve the problem.
examples.text_zh: 这一改变有可能解决这个问题。

examples.text_en: This can potentiate the work of the other part.
examples.text_zh: 这能增强另一部分的作用。

examples.text_en: They hope to potentiate the help for poor people.
examples.text_zh: 他们希望能加强对穷人的帮助。

examples.text_en: The witch mixed a strange magic potion.
examples.text_zh: 女巫调配了一种奇特的魔法药水。

examples.text_en: He drank the potion and fell asleep.
examples.text_zh: 他喝下那剂药水就睡着了。

examples.text_en: The show was a potpourri of songs and dances.
examples.text_zh: 这场演出是歌曲与舞蹈的大杂烩。

examples.text_en: Her book is a potpourri of short stories.
examples.text_zh: 她的书是短篇故事的大杂烩。

examples.text_en: They keep poultry on the land near the town.
examples.text_zh: 他们在镇子附近的土地上养家禽。

examples.text_en: Poultry is a key part of the food for the family.
examples.text_zh: 家禽是这个家庭食物的重要部分。

examples.text_en: The dog would pounce on the small thing.
examples.text_zh: 狗会向那个小东西猛扑过去。

examples.text_en: They pounce on every chance to win the game.
examples.text_zh: 他们抓住每一个机会去赢下比赛。

examples.text_en: The child would pout when she did not get her way.
examples.text_zh: 得不到想要的东西时，这孩子就会撅嘴生气。

examples.text_en: Do not pout over a small thing like this.
examples.text_zh: 不要为这样的小事撅嘴生气。

examples.text_en: This plan is practicable and we can start today.
examples.text_zh: 这个计划可行，我们今天就能开始。

examples.text_en: They looked for a practicable way to help the poor.
examples.text_zh: 他们在寻找帮助穷人的可行办法。

examples.text_en: We must think about the practicality of this plan.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须考虑这个计划的可行性。

examples.text_en: The idea sounds good, but its practicality is doubtful.
examples.text_zh: 这想法听着不错，但它的实用性可疑。

examples.text_en: She is a skilled medical practitioner.
examples.text_zh: 她是一位医术高明的医生。

examples.text_en: The practitioner gave him useful advice.
examples.text_zh: 这位从业者给了他有用的建议。

examples.text_en: The horse began to prance around the field.
examples.text_zh: 那匹马开始在田野里腾跃。

examples.text_en: Young horses prance happily in the spring.
examples.text_zh: 小马在春天欢快地腾跃。

examples.text_en: He likes to prate about his own success.
examples.text_zh: 他喜欢唠叨自己有多成功。

examples.text_en: They prate on and on without saying much.
examples.text_zh: 他们喋喋不休，却没说出什么内容。

examples.text_en: The preamble of the book was short and clear.
examples.text_zh: 这本书的序言简短而清晰。

examples.text_en: He read the preamble before he signed the paper.
examples.text_zh: 他在文件上签字前先读了序言。

examples.text_en: His hold on the job was precarious and not safe.
examples.text_zh: 他的这份工作岌岌可危，并不稳当。

examples.text_en: They lived in a precarious time after the war.
examples.text_zh: 战后他们生活在一段不稳定的时期。

examples.text_en: As a precaution, they kept the food in a safe place.
examples.text_zh: 为防万一，他们把食物放在一个安全的地方。

examples.text_en: We made a simple precaution before the long walk.
examples.text_zh: 在长途步行之前，我们做了简单的防范。

examples.text_en: We took simple precautions before the long trip.
examples.text_zh: 长途旅行前我们采取了简单的预防措施。

examples.text_en: Such precautions can prevent many common accidents.
examples.text_zh: 这样的预防措施能避免许多常见事故。

examples.text_en: A short talk will precede the main event today.
examples.text_zh: 今天主活动之前会有一段简短讲话。

examples.text_en: Bad news can precede a hard time to come.
examples.text_zh: 坏消息往往预示着困难时期的到来。

examples.text_en: This task takes precedence over the rest.
examples.text_zh: 这项任务比其余的都优先。

examples.text_en: Safety must take precedence over speed.
examples.text_zh: 安全必须优先于速度。

examples.text_en: He followed the wise precepts of his teacher.
examples.text_zh: 他遵循老师明智的规诫。

examples.text_en: A good precept is easy to remember.
examples.text_zh: 好的格言容易记住。

examples.text_en: She stood near the edge of the steep precipice.
examples.text_zh: 她站在陡峭悬崖的边缘附近。

examples.text_en: The car stopped right at the edge of the precipice.
examples.text_zh: 汽车正好停在悬崖边上。

examples.text_en: His move was rather precipitant and unwise.
examples.text_zh: 他的举动相当仓促，也不明智。

examples.text_en: Such a precipitant choice may cause trouble.
examples.text_zh: 这样仓促的选择可能招来麻烦。

examples.text_en: A white precipitate formed at the base of the water.
examples.text_zh: 水底出现了一层白色沉淀物。

examples.text_en: The precipitate of the event was a great change.
examples.text_zh: 这件事的结果是一场巨大的变化。

examples.text_en: The precipitation was high in the south this year.
examples.text_zh: 今年南方的降水量很高。

examples.text_en: They watch precipitation to understand the local water.
examples.text_zh: 他们观测降水，以了解当地的水情。

examples.text_en: The precipitous road was hard to walk on.
examples.text_zh: 这条陡峭的路很难走。

examples.text_en: It was a precipitous choice that we all questioned.
examples.text_zh: 那是个仓促的决定，我们对它都有疑问。

examples.text_en: Bad news can preclude a walk in the park.
examples.text_zh: 坏消息可能会妨碍我们去公园散步。

examples.text_en: This law will preclude any change to the plan.
examples.text_zh: 这条法律将阻止对计划的任何改动。

examples.text_en: The precocious child read books far above her age.
examples.text_zh: 这个早熟的孩子读的书远超她的年龄。

examples.text_en: He was a precocious student with great talent.
examples.text_zh: 他是个才华出众的早熟学生。

examples.text_en: This small device was a precursor of the modern phone.
examples.text_zh: 这个小装置是现代电话的前身。

examples.text_en: These early songs were a precursor to jazz.
examples.text_zh: 这些早期的歌曲是爵士乐的前身。

examples.text_en: The predator moved through the dark land at night.
examples.text_zh: 这只食肉动物夜里在黑暗的土地上穿行。

examples.text_en: A strong predator can take food from the group.
examples.text_zh: 强大的捕食者能从群体中抢走食物。

examples.text_en: They were a predatory group and took what they wanted.
examples.text_zh: 他们是一群掠夺者，想要什么就抢什么。

examples.text_en: The predatory look on his face was clear to all.
examples.text_zh: 他脸上那种掠夺的神情大家都看得出来。

examples.text_en: Some people believe that time will predestine our life.
examples.text_zh: 有些人相信时间会注定我们的一生。

examples.text_en: They felt the event was predestined from the start.
examples.text_zh: 他们觉得这件事从一开始就是注定好的。

examples.text_en: He found himself in a difficult predicament.
examples.text_zh: 他发现自己陷入了困境。

examples.text_en: The family faced a serious predicament.
examples.text_zh: 这家人面临着严峻的困境。

examples.text_en: The predictability of the plan made it easy to follow.
examples.text_zh: 这个计划的可预测性让它容易执行。

examples.text_en: We like the predictability of the daily work here.
examples.text_zh: 我们喜欢这里日常工作的可预测性。

examples.text_en: His answer was predictable and not at all new.
examples.text_zh: 他的回答在意料之中，一点都不新鲜。

examples.text_en: The end of the story was very predictable.
examples.text_zh: 这个故事的结局非常容易预料。

examples.text_en: The model has good predictive power.
examples.text_zh: 这个模型有很好的预测能力。

examples.text_en: Such tests are useful but not always predictive.
examples.text_zh: 这类测试有用，但并非总能预测。

examples.text_en: She has a predilection for sweet food.
examples.text_zh: 她偏爱甜食。

examples.text_en: His predilection for rare maps is well known.
examples.text_zh: 他对珍稀地图的偏爱是众所周知的。

examples.text_en: He has a predisposition to work with young children.
examples.text_zh: 他天生适合和幼儿打交道。

examples.text_en: Her predisposition for art was from her family.
examples.text_zh: 她对艺术的偏好来自她的家庭。

examples.text_en: Blue is the predominant color in this room.
examples.text_zh: 蓝色是这个房间的主色调。

examples.text_en: One team was predominant in the first half.
examples.text_zh: 上半场一支队伍占据主导。

examples.text_en: The group is predominantly made of young people.
examples.text_zh: 这个小组主要由年轻人组成。

examples.text_en: They live predominantly in the south of the city.
examples.text_zh: 他们主要住在城市的南部。

examples.text_en: Young people predominate in this part of the city.
examples.text_zh: 城市这一带以年轻人为主。

examples.text_en: One group can predominate if the rules are not clear.
examples.text_zh: 如果规则不清楚，一个群体就可能占主导。

examples.text_en: She is a preeminent scholar in her field.
examples.text_zh: 她所在领域里是一位杰出学者。

examples.text_en: The city has a preeminent medical school.
examples.text_zh: 这座城市有一所卓越的医学院。

examples.text_en: They moved fast to preempt the other group.
examples.text_zh: 他们迅速行动，抢先于另一组。

examples.text_en: A small step can preempt a big problem later.
examples.text_zh: 小小一步就能预防日后的大问题。

examples.text_en: The bird began to preen its bright feathers.
examples.text_zh: 那只鸟开始用嘴梳理鲜亮的羽毛。

examples.text_en: She likes to preen before the mirror.
examples.text_zh: 她喜欢在镜子前精心打扮。

examples.text_en: They built a prefabricated house in a single day.
examples.text_zh: 他们一天就建成了一座预制房屋。

examples.text_en: The prefabricated part was easy to move and use.
examples.text_zh: 这个预制的部件容易搬运和使用。

examples.text_en: The author wrote a short preface for the book.
examples.text_zh: 作者为这本书写了一篇简短的前言。

examples.text_en: He read the preface before the main text.
examples.text_zh: 在正文之前他先读了前言。

examples.text_en: Her preference for the new plan was quite clear.
examples.text_zh: 她对这项新计划的偏爱相当明显。

examples.text_en: We all have a preference for good food and rest.
examples.text_zh: 我们都偏爱美食和休息。

examples.text_en: These events prefigure the war that followed.
examples.text_zh: 这些事件预示了随后发生的战争。

examples.text_en: His early work prefigures the style he later chose.
examples.text_zh: 他早期的作品预示了他后来选择的风格。

examples.text_en: The prehensile part can hold a small thing well.
examples.text_zh: 这个能抓握的部分能牢牢抓住小东西。

examples.text_en: A prehensile hand can take food from a high place.
examples.text_zh: 能抓握的手可以从高处取到食物。

examples.text_en: They found prehistoric tools near the river.
examples.text_zh: 他们在河边发现了史前工具。

examples.text_en: The cave holds paintings from prehistoric times.
examples.text_zh: 这个洞穴里有史前时代的壁画。

examples.text_en: The preliminary report was short and to the point.
examples.text_zh: 初步报告简短而切中要点。

examples.text_en: They held a preliminary talk before the main meeting.
examples.text_zh: 在主会议之前他们先进行了一场初步讨论。

examples.text_en: Such stories come from preliterate societies.
examples.text_zh: 这类故事来自尚无文字的社会。

examples.text_en: The preliterate village kept its history in songs.
examples.text_zh: 这个没有文字的村庄用歌谣保存历史。

examples.text_en: The quiet music was a prelude to the storm.
examples.text_zh: 轻柔的音乐是暴风雨的前奏。

examples.text_en: This small fight was a prelude to war.
examples.text_zh: 这场小冲突是战争的前奏。

examples.text_en: He seemed to premeditate every single move.
examples.text_zh: 他似乎对每一步都事先谋划。

examples.text_en: Nobody thinks she would premeditate such a crime.
examples.text_zh: 没人认为她会预谋犯下这样的罪行。

examples.text_en: The film will premiere in the city tonight.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影今晚将在城里首映。

examples.text_en: Her new play will premiere next month.
examples.text_zh: 她的新剧下个月首演。

examples.text_en: They pay a premium for the best food in town.
examples.text_zh: 他们为镇上最好的食物支付额外的费用。

examples.text_en: The premium on this plan was high last year.
examples.text_zh: 这项计划的保险费用去年很高。

examples.text_en: His preoccupation with the game made him forget work.
examples.text_zh: 他对比赛的专注让他忘了工作。

examples.text_en: Her main preoccupation was the health of her family.
examples.text_zh: 她最挂心的是家人的健康。

examples.text_en: There was a preponderance of young people in the group.
examples.text_zh: 这个小组里年轻人占绝大多数。

examples.text_en: The preponderance of food was from the south.
examples.text_zh: 大部分食物来自南方。

examples.text_en: Their team held a preponderant share of the votes.
examples.text_zh: 他们队伍掌握了多数选票。

examples.text_en: She plays a preponderant role in the group.
examples.text_zh: 她在这个群体中起主要作用。

examples.text_en: One voice can preponderate in a small group.
examples.text_zh: 在小组里，一种声音可能占上风。

examples.text_en: Good sense will preponderate when people talk it over.
examples.text_zh: 人们商量之后，正确的判断会占上风。

examples.text_en: The young man had a prepossessing smile.
examples.text_zh: 那个年轻人有着讨人喜欢的笑容。

examples.text_en: Her manner was warm and quite prepossessing.
examples.text_zh: 她的举止热情，很是讨人喜欢。

examples.text_en: That is a preposterous idea and makes no sense.
examples.text_zh: 那是个荒谬的想法，毫无道理。

examples.text_en: It was a preposterous thing to say to the king.
examples.text_zh: 对国王说这种话太荒谬了。

examples.text_en: Deciding such matters is her prerogative.
examples.text_zh: 决定这类事情是她的特权。

examples.text_en: That choice is her own prerogative.
examples.text_zh: 那个选择是她自己的特权。

examples.text_en: The dark night can presage a hard time to come.
examples.text_zh: 漆黑的夜晚可能预示着困难时期的到来。

examples.text_en: A bad start may presage a long hard year.
examples.text_zh: 一个糟糕的开端可能预示着艰难的一年。

examples.text_en: Her prescience about the market was a great help.
examples.text_zh: 她对市场的预知帮了大忙。

examples.text_en: He had the prescience to save food for hard times.
examples.text_zh: 他有先见之明，为困难时期存下了食物。

examples.text_en: The doctor will prescribe some medicine for you.
examples.text_zh: 医生会给你开些药。

examples.text_en: Teachers often prescribe books for the class.
examples.text_zh: 老师常为班级指定读物。

examples.text_en: The presenter smiled at the large crowd.
examples.text_zh: 主持人对着人群微笑。

examples.text_en: A young presenter read the evening news.
examples.text_zh: 一位年轻的主持人播报了晚间新闻。

examples.text_en: She had a presentiment that something bad would come.
examples.text_zh: 她预感到会有不好的事情发生。

examples.text_en: His presentiment about the event made him stay home.
examples.text_zh: 他对这件事的预感让他留在了家里。

examples.text_en: The group works for the preservation of wild forests.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体致力于保护野生森林。

examples.text_en: Good preservation keeps this food fresh for months.
examples.text_zh: 良好的保存能让这种食物保鲜数月。

examples.text_en: You can preset the oven before you cook.
examples.text_zh: 你可以在做饭前预先设定烤箱。

examples.text_en: We preset the lights for the evening show.
examples.text_zh: 我们为晚场演出预先调好灯光。

examples.text_en: She will preside over the meeting today.
examples.text_zh: 她今天将主持这场会议。

examples.text_en: A senior judge will preside at the trial.
examples.text_zh: 一位资深法官将主持庭审。

examples.text_en: This is a pressing problem that needs our care.
examples.text_zh: 这是个需要我们去关注的紧迫问题。

examples.text_en: They had a pressing need for more food and water.
examples.text_zh: 他们迫切需要更多的食物和水。

examples.text_en: She won a prestigious award for her work.
examples.text_zh: 她因工作赢得了一个享有声望的奖项。

examples.text_en: He teaches at a prestigious local school.
examples.text_zh: 他在一所享有声望的本地学校任教。

examples.text_en: The presumable cost of the plan is quite high.
examples.text_zh: 这个计划可推测的成本相当高。

examples.text_en: His presumable reason was a need for more time.
examples.text_zh: 他大概的理由是需要更多时间。

examples.text_en: She is presumably at home with the young children.
examples.text_zh: 她大概在家照看年幼的孩子。

examples.text_en: The meeting will presumably end in a short time.
examples.text_zh: 会议大概很快就会结束。

examples.text_en: His presumption about the cost proved wrong.
examples.text_zh: 他对费用的推测被证明是错的。

examples.text_en: The court made a fair presumption of innocence.
examples.text_zh: 法庭作出了无罪这一公正的推定。

examples.text_en: It was presumptuous of him to ask.
examples.text_zh: 他那样问有些冒昧。

examples.text_en: Her presumptuous manner upset the entire team.
examples.text_zh: 她放肆的态度让整个团队都不快。

examples.text_en: The argument rests on a false presupposition.
examples.text_zh: 这个论点建立在一个错误的前提上。

examples.text_en: His plan began with a simple presupposition.
examples.text_zh: 他的计划始于一个简单的假设。

examples.text_en: He made no pretence of liking the food.
examples.text_zh: 他毫不掩饰自己不喜欢这食物。

examples.text_en: Her calm manner was only a pretence.
examples.text_zh: 她平静的举止只是假装。

examples.text_en: His friendly smile was mere pretense.
examples.text_zh: 他友好的微笑不过是伪装。

examples.text_en: She kept up the pretense for many years.
examples.text_zh: 她这个假象维持了许多年。

examples.text_en: His pretension made him hard to like at all.
examples.text_zh: 他的自负让人很难喜欢他。

examples.text_en: She has no pretension and is easy to talk to.
examples.text_zh: 她毫无架子，很好交谈。

examples.text_en: The pretentious man loved to talk about his art.
examples.text_zh: 这个自命不凡的人喜欢谈论自己的艺术。

examples.text_en: It was a pretentious show with little real use.
examples.text_zh: 那是一场没什么实际用处的自命不凡的表演。

examples.text_en: The dog had a preternatural sense of danger.
examples.text_zh: 这只狗对危险有超乎寻常的感知。

examples.text_en: Her calm was almost preternatural that night.
examples.text_zh: 那天晚上她的镇定几乎异乎寻常。

examples.text_en: The prevailing view in the group was to wait.
examples.text_zh: 小组里普遍的看法是先等待。

examples.text_en: The prevailing style in the city was quite new.
examples.text_zh: 这座城市流行的风格相当新颖。

examples.text_en: The prevalence of the problem was clear to everyone.
examples.text_zh: 这个问题的普遍程度对每个人来说都很清楚。

examples.text_en: They read about the prevalence of the problem in the south.
examples.text_zh: 他们读到过这一问题在南方的普遍程度。

examples.text_en: This custom is still prevalent in rural areas.
examples.text_zh: 这种习俗在农村地区仍很普遍。

examples.text_en: Such views were prevalent among young people.
examples.text_zh: 这类看法在年轻人中很流行。
